messages:
Ava (CS Manager): alert—several onboarding flows for late-stage trials timed out after embedding/index steps. need a short customer-facing status + how were compensating.
Ben (Account Exec): saw 2 renewal-risk accounts hit this. can we include a direct note for renewals team? small gesture appreciated.
Sofia (Success Ops): can eng/sre confirm root cause + ETA for full remediation? ill draft copy once we have that.
Marco (Eng): root cause: aggressive KV cache eviction under burst embeddings leading to repeated re-computations and request latency. reproduced locally. patch to reduce eviction aggressiveness + add LRU pinning merged at 2024-11-12T14:20Z and deployed to staging.
Ellen (SRE): production observation window 13:500:10 UTC, error spike ~9% for embed/index calls. temporarily throttled parallel embeders and increased cache size; errors down to ~1.2%.
Sofia (Success Ops): draft outbound (short): "Hi—we experienced intermittent onboarding timeouts affecting embeddings and indexing for some customers today. Status: fix deployed to staging and mitigations applied in prod; were monitoring a 24h canary. Next: full prod rollout within 36h if stable. Compensation: one-time onboarding credit applied automatically to affected accounts. Office hours: 30m Q&A Monday 16:00 UTC (recording available). Support form: https://support.redwood.ai/onboard-credit"
Ava (CS Manager): edit: change "one-time onboarding credit" → "one-time onboarding credit (applied automatically)". Also add line for renewals team: "If you manage renewal conversations for impacted accounts, ping me & Ben for a tailored note."
Ben (Account Exec): thanks — I need the list of affected trial accounts to reach out proactively.
Sofia (Success Ops): will export list and DM it to renewals. credit application ETA: within 48h of outbound.
Marco (Eng): technical note well attach to RCA: "KV eviction policy mis-tuned for high-concurrency embedding bursts; implemented LRU pin for in-flight keys and added telemetry for cache churn."
Ellen (SRE): action items: 1) rollback guard if eviction still spikes 2) add alert for cache eviction rate > 5% sustained 3) daily runbook check for 72h post-rollout.
Sofia (Success Ops): OpsBot please create incident and calendar event.
OpsBot: Incident created: INC-2024-1298. Event: "Onboard embeddings outage Q&A" scheduled 2024-11-13T16:00:00Z. Recording will be posted to ticket.
Ava (CS Manager): who will host the office hours?
Sofia (Success Ops): ill host CS; Marco + Ellen join for tech. Ben can open with renewal outreach notes.
Ben (Account Exec): I can do the renewal bits. pls include me on attendee list for high-touch trials.
Sofia (Success Ops): quick ask — legal ok on the outbound tone?
Ava (CS Manager): legal gave a quick thumbs-up earlier but wants us not to promise SLA credits; keep it as a one-time goodwill credit.
Marco (Eng): ETA for full prod rollout: monitoring 24h canary, if green then rolling within 306h. will notify here before rollout.
Ellen (SRE): ill post monitoring dashboard links once canary telemetry is stable.
Sofia (Success Ops): final outbound will be sent EOD after legal check. please react with :white_check_mark: when youve reviewed the customer copy.
Marco (Eng): :white_check_mark:
Ellen (SRE): :white_check_mark:
Ben (Account Exec): :white_check_mark: will prep renewal outreach template.
Ava (CS Manager): thanks all. closing thread for now  will reopen with RCA + recording after office hours."
